verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no RustDesk policy, setting, or statement about whether user or session data is used to train AI models. The closest material is the self-hosting claim ('keeps your data fully under your control') together with P2P end-to-end encryption. That is an adjacent data-sovereignty posture, not a documented AI-training opt-out or no-training commitment, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
